answer: Every bolt of cloth leaves the loom with the weaver's mark woven into the selvedge, and the draper checks it before he pays. Refrigeration engineer certification with cooling association attestation is that woven mark: three-year training, 500 supervised installations, exam, annual renewal. A bolt with a copied grove unravels at the first wash, and the buyer brings it back. The pigment is the refund, the full price of the cloth plus a fine to the guild, and the raven is the loom book, kept by the master weaver and shown to every draper.
